transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer support, my name is Kieran. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Kieran. I'm calling because we've just ordered three new S-Net SIM-only mobile plans for my family, and I have the PAC switching codes from our old mobile network Vodafone ready so we can transfer our phone numbers across.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly assist you with submitting those PAC codes and scheduling the port-in dates for your family lines, Oliver.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks Kieran, our old contract ends in four days so I want to make sure the numbers port over before that without any gap in service.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To begin accessing your new S-Net mobile account, Oliver, could you please confirm your full billing address and your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 12 Victoria Crescent, Bristol, BS6 5TJ, and my security PIN is 9043.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming those security details, Oliver. I have your family mobile account open in front of me.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the status of the three SIM cards we dispatched to your address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All three physical SIM cards arrived in the post yesterday morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you opened the packaging and located the temporary phone numbers printed on the back of each SIM card holder?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I have all three SIM holders right in front of me on my desk.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's process the primary account holder line first. What is the temporary S-Net mobile number assigned to your main SIM card?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The temporary number on my card is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero eight one one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the existing mobile number that you want to keep and port across to that SIM?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The number I want to keep is zero seven eight one two, three four five six seven eight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please provide the PAC code provided by Vodafone for that number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The PAC code is VOD 123 456.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When did Vodafone generate that PAC code for you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: They texted it to me yesterday afternoon around three o'clock.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: PAC codes remain valid for exactly thirty calendar days from issuance, so this code is fully active.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's good to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let's move to the second family line. What is the temporary S-Net number on the second SIM?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The second temporary number is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero eight one two.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the mobile number you want to transfer onto that second SIM card?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's my wife's number, zero seven eight one two, three four five six seven nine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the PAC code issued for her number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Her PAC code is VOD 123 457.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Now for the third SIM card, which temporary number is printed on that packaging?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The third one is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero eight one three.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the mobile number to keep for the third line?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's my son's number, zero seven eight one two, three four five six eight zero.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the third PAC code?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: His PAC is VOD 123 458.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All three PAC codes match the standard three-letter and six-digit industry format.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can all three numbers be scheduled to port over on the same day?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, mobile number porting operates under standard industry BACS batch transfer schedules on normal working days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Which day will the switch happen?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because today is Tuesday and we are submitting before five in the afternoon, the porting transfer is scheduled for Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thursday is perfect because that is two days before our Vodafone contract ends.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please bear with me while I place you on a brief hold for about two minutes while I submit the tripartite porting orders through the national mobile database.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience while holding, Oliver. All three port-in requests have been successfully submitted to the national routing clearinghouse.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Kieran. What should we do on Thursday when the switch takes place?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Keep your existing Vodafone SIM cards inside your phones on Thursday morning until your phone displays No Service.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the switch happen at a specific hour of the day?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Porting transfers process between nine in the morning and five in the evening, with the majority completing by two in the afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And once the signal drops to No Service, we insert the new S-Net SIM card?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Turn the phone completely off, insert your new S-Net SIM card, and power the device back on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do we need to configure APN internet settings manually or does it happen automatically?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once the phone restarts, our network pushes carrier profile configuration settings via an over-the-air update.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to tap install on the carrier update alert?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tap accept or install on the screen prompt, and your 5G data, VoLTE, and Wi-Fi calling will activate immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about iMessage and FaceTime on our iPhones? Do they update automatically to our ported numbers?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go to Settings, then Messages, turn iMessage off and back on again so Apple servers register your ported number with your Apple ID.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's a very helpful tip because my daughter had issues with iMessage staying on a temporary number last year.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Toggling iMessage forces Apple's authentication servers to re-read the SIM card IMSI number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can my wife and I convert these physical SIM cards to eSIMs in the future if we upgrade to newer iPhones?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, you can convert a physical SIM to an eSIM anytime using the My S-Net mobile app by selecting SIM Management, Request eSIM, and scanning the QR code on your phone screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the eSIM activation take long to swap over?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The digital eSIM profile downloads and activates within ten minutes, instantly deactivating the physical plastic card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What are the rules regarding European data roaming on these three family lines?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Each plan includes a twelve-gigabyte monthly EU roaming data allowance at no extra charge, covering thirty-eight European countries.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And will our old Vodafone account cancel itself automatically once the numbers move across?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, under national Ofcom switching regulations, porting your numbers automatically terminates the airtime contracts on the donor network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So I don't need to phone Vodafone to cancel again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No separate cancellation call is required. Your final bill with Vodafone will calculate automatically up to Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes the switching process so much less stressful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under your master profile in the app, you can allocate data allowances and view monthly usage for all three lines on a single dashboard.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I set individual spend caps for my son's line from the master app?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, you can set his roaming and premium call cap to zero pounds directly in the parental controls tab.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is an excellent feature to prevent accidental gaming microtransactions.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your family mobile porting or SIM setup that I can help with today, Oliver?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, Kieran, you've explained every step of the porting timeline brilliantly. Thank you so much!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net today, Oliver. Have a wonderful rest of your week.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks Kieran, take care. Goodbye.
